sentences.en: In New Jersey are many unobtrusive buildings.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州有许多不显眼的建筑。

sentences.en: The old man prefers to live in an unobtrusive manner.
sentences.zh: 这位老人喜欢低调地生活。

sentences.en: She wore simple jewelry, keeping a very unobtrusive appearance.
sentences.zh: 她戴着简单的首饰，看上去非常低调。

senses.zh: 不突出的；不显眼的；谦虚的
